decisions.reason: As a close-to-core facial care line with several variants and its own page, it looks like a committed extension that is still inexpensive for the firm to keep while market feedback continues to come in.

The hyaluronic serum fits the firm's established skincare capabilities and can be left on the market as a low-cost option, though its lighter web presence suggests somewhat weaker commitment and more scope for later pruning if demand disappoints.

The cleansing milk is also close to the core offer and likely cheap to maintain, but because it is only briefly mentioned and appears less emphasized, the firm has a somewhat higher chance of dropping it if early results do not justify shelf space and attention.
